input.title: Software Engineer | $70/hr Remote
input.description:
Position: Software Engineer

Type: Contract

Compensation: $50 - $70/hour

Location: Remote

Commitment: 10-40 hrs/week


Role Responsibilities

 * Execute structured evaluation assignments simulating developer activities using AI-powered tools.
 * Assess and grade technical correctness of outputs within development environments.
 * Design and maintain reproducible test environments with real commit histories and CI workflows.
 * Configure and troubleshoot integrations across multiple software services for seamless connectivity.
 * Investigate and document undocumented product behaviors through systematic testing.
 * Participate in calibration sessions to ensure consistent evaluation methods.


Requirements

 * Have strong relevant experience in software engineering with Git/GitHub workflows.
 * Proficient with CI/CD systems, ideally GitHub Actions, and authoring custom workflows.
 * Advanced scripting abilities in Python or Bash, with understanding of REST APIs and OAuth.
 * Fluency with major enterprise SaaS platforms; administrative experience in cloud workspaces is advantageous.
 * Experience leveraging AI assistants or agent tools in developer tasks is a plus.
 * Background in technical QA, evaluation, or data annotation with consistency in applying rubrics.


Application Process

 * Easy Apply on LinkedIn
 * Check email for next steps
 * Participate in resume evaluation & interview stage
